entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thanks again for letting me join you.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: To be honest, prelims are coming[n]up soon, so I didn't want to take[n]any chances of getting sick.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Two huge competitions are coming up—[n]one at the beginning of summer and[n]one near the end.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: If I'm going to participate in the prelims,[n]I have to be selected as my club's[n]representative...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: And there's a qualifier meet to[n]determine who that rep will be.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's my dream to compete in gymnastics[n]on the global level.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: So, I plan on maintaining a strict[n]training regimen with my coach.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But it's for my dream, so I'm willing to[n]put in every bit of effort that I have.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'd be invincible if I had you cheering[n]me on, Senpai! *giggle*

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, we're already at the station...
